meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 做出一份可点击、能分支跳转、带演讲备注的演示幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把想法或网页做成能上台演示的交互幻灯片。
copy.tagline_en: Build a clickable presentation deck with branching and speaker notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn ideas or a webpage into an interactive deck to present.

howto.what: Claude 会把你给的演示内容写成 HyperFrames 幻灯片:一套可导航的 slide,带分支、热点跳转和演讲者备注,也能把已有网页转成幻灯片。产出是可现场演示的 deck,不是导出的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做 slideshow、演示文稿等,或要把已有页面转成幻灯片时接管;若你没明说,它会先问一句确认再动手。

say.text: 在这一页加个热点,点了跳到市场调研那几页

howto.what_en: Claude turns your material into a HyperFrames slideshow: a navigable deck of discrete slides with branches, hotspot links and speaker notes, and can convert an existing page into a deck. Output is a live presentable deck, not a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, presentation or pitch deck, or to convert an existing page into a deck; if you didn't ask for one, it confirms with a yes/no question before authoring.

say_en.text: Turn this content into a HyperFrames slideshow
say_en.note: It confirms first, then builds the deck

Add a hotspot here that jumps to the market sizing slides
